key.access: Public search, with case-sensitive filtering for genus and epithet after retrieval. Exact headword groups are allowed. A match identifies candidate text, with the relevant taxon checked separately for each adopted finding.

eponymDictionary.access: Publisher preview of the electronic edition. The printed pages through p. 61 were searched against the catalogue, including displayed alternative combinations.

method: Search every current and alternate scientific-name component used by the catalogue. Compare exact Key headwords with the existing English explanations and the extracted 2010 print entries.

Screen for new word origins, competing interpretations, name transfers and explicit dedications. Check the applicable taxon, original descriptions quoted by the Key and corroborating publications where available. Publish original short explanations in German, English and Dutch.

Match catalogue binomials against the accessible eponym dictionary text and confirm the selected passages and printed page numbers. Related subspecies and homonyms are kept out of the species explanation unless the source supports the catalogue taxon.
